recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The specification source already matches the WG decision, and adding a replacement value[x] binding or extra guidance would risk contradicting the reason the binding was removed.
issue_request: FHIR-41419 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Group. It requested removing the broken example binding named GroupCharacteristicValue from Group.characteristic.value[x] and adding an example ValueSet for Group.characteristic.code.
initial_application: March 2025 history applied the request before this reconciliation: commit 191fa02f0491ac1c45c574c4cc95daef019aa472 explicitly lists FHIR-41419, removes the binding block from Group.characteristic.value[x], adds the example-characteristic-codes binding to Group.characteristic.code, and creates the ValueSet; commit 0e115c86c96da9921b9f9610b020fba08dbc210c registers that ValueSet in source/fhir.ini.
additional_context: FHIR-I 2024-08-19 minutes confirm the 7-0-0 Persuasive with Modification decision and the exact scope. Zulip discussion identified the same unlinked Group bindings and supports not defining a broad Group.characteristic.value set because those values can legitimately be anything depending on the code. A lone GroupCharacteristicValue entry remains in source/bindings.ini, but no current authoritative Group source references that binding name outside the registry line.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml has no binding under Group.characteristic.value[x], binds Group.characteristic.code to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/example-characteristic-codes, and source/fhir.ini actively includes group\valueset-example-characteristic-codes.xml in [valuesets].

related_jiras.note: The historical implementation commit used FHIR-43501 as its subject while also applying FHIR-41419 to the same Group StructureDefinition; FHIR-43501 itself concerns Group.characteristic.instances[x] constraints and was not decided here.
